Class Blackboard

java.lang.Object
primitives.Blackboard
public class Blackboard extends Object
Reusable target-area sampler for all super-sampling image improvements.

A Blackboard represents a flat, 2D sampling region centered at a configurable world-space point. It generates a list of 3D sample points distributed across that region according to the chosen Blackboard.SamplingPattern and Blackboard.TargetShape, then maps them into world space using two orthonormal local basis vectors.

The same infrastructure is shared by every super-sampling feature:

  • Anti-aliasing – pixel area on the view plane
  • Depth of Field – aperture window around the camera origin
  • Soft Shadows – area around a positional light source
  • Glossy / Diffuse Glass – virtual target area placed on the ideal secondary (reflection / refraction) ray

Typical usage (method-chaining): 

List<Point> samples = new Blackboard()
    .setCenter(lightPosition)
    .setSize(lightRadius)
    .setNumSamples(81)
    .setPattern(SamplingPattern.JITTERED)
    .setShape(TargetShape.CIRCLE)
    .buildBasis(shadowRayDirection)
    .getSamplePoints();

Caching policy:

  • Blackboard.SamplingPattern.GRID – the point list is computed once and cached until any parameter changes.
  • Blackboard.SamplingPattern.RANDOM and Blackboard.SamplingPattern.JITTERED – a fresh list is generated on every getSamplePoints() call to preserve stochastic variation across pixels.

    • _size

      private double _size
      Half-side length (for Blackboard.TargetShape.SQUARE) or radius (for Blackboard.TargetShape.CIRCLE) of the target area, in world units. A value of 0 disables spreading: getSamplePoints() returns only the center point, effectively turning off super-sampling for this beam.

    • _numSamples

      private int _numSamples
      Target number of sample points.

      For Blackboard.SamplingPattern.GRID and Blackboard.SamplingPattern.JITTERED the actual count is ⌈√n⌉², which may differ slightly from this value. For Blackboard.SamplingPattern.RANDOM exactly this many points are returned (circle filtering keeps generating until the count is met).

      Default: 9 (equivalent to a 3 × 3 grid).

    • _pattern

      private Blackboard.SamplingPattern _pattern
      Distribution pattern for sample points. Default: Blackboard.SamplingPattern.GRID.

    • _shape

      private Blackboard.TargetShape _shape
      Shape of the target area. Default: Blackboard.TargetShape.SQUARE.

    • _cachedSamples

      private List<Point> _cachedSamples
      Cached sample list, valid only for Blackboard.SamplingPattern.GRID. Set to null by invalidateCache() whenever any parameter that affects sample generation changes. Blackboard.SamplingPattern.RANDOM and Blackboard.SamplingPattern.JITTERED never populate this field.

    • setBasis

      public Blackboard setBasis(Vector vX, Vector vY)
      Sets the local X/Y basis vectors directly.

      Use this when the basis is already known — for example, when the target area is the view plane and the basis vectors are the camera's vRight and vUp vectors (anti-aliasing, depth of field). Both vectors are normalized before storage.

      Parameters:
      vX - the horizontal axis of the target area
      vY - the vertical axis of the target area
      Returns:
      this Blackboard for chaining

    • buildBasis

      public Blackboard buildBasis(Vector normal)
      Computes two orthonormal basis vectors for the target area from a given normal direction and stores them as _vX and _vY.

      The resulting vectors are both perpendicular to normal and to each other, forming a local 2D coordinate system in the plane of the target area.

      Call this when the target area's orientation is defined only by its facing direction — for example:

      • Soft shadows with a PointLight: pass the direction from the light to the surface point (l).
      • Soft shadows with a SpotLight: pass the spotlight's beam direction (dir).
      • Glossy / diffuse: pass the ideal reflection or refraction direction.
      Parameters:
      normal - the direction perpendicular to the target-area plane; must be a valid (non-zero) direction vector — it need not be normalized beforehand
      Returns:
      this Blackboard for chaining

    • getSamplePoints

      public List<Point> getSamplePoints()
      Returns the list of 3D world-space sample points for the current configuration.

      Edge cases:

      • If size == 0, or the basis vectors have not been set via setBasis(Vector, Vector) / buildBasis(Vector), a single-element list containing only _center is returned (super-sampling is effectively off).
      • If the center has not been set, an empty list is returned.
      Returns:
      a non-null list of at least one sample point

    • offsetToPoint

      private Point offsetToPoint(double x, double y)
      Converts a 2D offset (x, y) in the local coordinate system of the target area into a 3D world-space Point.

      Zero offsets are skipped explicitly because Vector.scale(double) with a zero scalar would construct the illegal zero vector and throw an exception.

      Parameters:
      x - offset along the _vX (horizontal) axis
      y - offset along the _vY (vertical) axis
      Returns:
      the corresponding 3D world-space point

    • generateGrid

      private List<Point> generateGrid()
      Generates a regular gridSize × gridSize grid of sample points, where gridSize = ⌈√numSamples⌉.

      Each sample is placed at the center of its grid cell. When Blackboard.TargetShape.CIRCLE is active, samples outside the inscribed circle are discarded (approximately 4/π ≈ 1.273× more cells are generated than the target count to compensate).

      Falls back to a single center point if all candidates are filtered out.

      Returns:
      list of grid sample points in 3D world space; never null

    • generateRandom

      private List<Point> generateRandom()
      Generates exactly _numSamples fully random sample points inside the target area.

      For Blackboard.TargetShape.CIRCLE an accept-reject loop is used: candidate points are drawn uniformly from the enclosing square and discarded if they fall outside the circle. This is the standard unbiased approach; the expected number of candidates required per accepted sample is 4/π ≈ 1.273.

      Returns:
      list of random sample points in 3D world space; never null

    • generateJittered

      private List<Point> generateJittered()
      Generates jittered sample points: one per grid cell, each randomly displaced within its cell by an offset in [-cellSize/2, +cellSize/2].

      This combines the even coverage of Blackboard.SamplingPattern.GRID with the natural irregularity of Blackboard.SamplingPattern.RANDOM, avoiding both the repetitive pattern artifacts of a pure grid and the clustering of pure random sampling.

      When Blackboard.TargetShape.CIRCLE is active, samples that fall outside the inscribed circle after jittering are discarded. Falls back to a single center point if all candidates are filtered out.

      Returns:
      list of jittered sample points in 3D world space; never null

    • invalidateCache

      private void invalidateCache()
      Clears the cached Grid sample list. Called automatically by every setter that affects sample generation, ensuring that stale cached points are never returned after a configuration change.
